title: Raspberry Pi AI System Combines GPT, Claude & Gemini Into One Smart Assistant🤯
description:
Meet the AI System That Makes GPT, Claude & Gemini Debate Before Answering 🤯 | Raspberry Pi MAGI Computer

What if three of the world's most advanced AI models discussed every question before giving you an answer? This fan-made project, inspired by the MAGI supercomputer from Neon Genesis Evangelion, uses a Raspberry Pi 5 to connect GPT-5.4, Claude Opus 4.6, and Gemini 3.1 Pro into a single AI system.

Instead of relying on one model, the system sends the same prompt to all three AIs. Each generates its own response, reviews the others' reasoning, and helps produce a final consensus answer. This multi-agent AI approach aims to improve reasoning, reduce hallucinations, and deliver more balanced results for complex questions.

The Raspberry Pi acts as the control hub, communicating with cloud-based AI services through APIs while displaying the responses on a custom touchscreen interface inspired by the fictional MAGI computer. The AI processing itself happens in the cloud, not on the Raspberry Pi.

Inspired by MAGI's three decision-making personalities—Melchior, Balthasar, and Casper—this project demonstrates how collaborative AI systems could influence the future of research, coding, engineering, and decision-making by combining the strengths of multiple AI models.

This is an independent fan-made demonstration and is not an official product from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or the creators of Evangelion.

Credits: LabHumanoid (Fan-made demonstration inspired by Neon Genesis Evangelion's MAGI system.)
